# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.1.0

Version 1.1.0 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## New

- **Menus of the port's own.** The pause menu and the settings are windows over the game now, no longer text in the
  game's font moved with the game's buttons: use them with the mouse (hover, click, wheel), the keyboard (arrows,
  Enter, Esc) or a gamepad (D-pad, A, B) on PC, and with your fingers on Android (tap; drag to scroll; the on-screen pad
  hides meanwhile). Korean or English (Settings → Interface → Language; automatic = Korean with the Korean patch or a
  Korean system), and the menu size can be changed there. Settings apply at once; a resolution change reverts after
  15 seconds unless you keep it. Controls: click a cell, press the key or button.
- **HD texture packs.** Settings → **HD textures** → **Install a texture pack (zip)...** takes a Dolphin HD texture pack
  zip as downloaded and reads it straight from the zip (nothing is unpacked: the 160 MB zip stays 160 MB). Textures load
  on a thread while you play, with no restart. Made and checked with the
  [Animal Crossing HD Texture Pack v25](https://forums.dolphin-emu.org/Thread-animal-crossing-hd-texture-pack-version-25-october-11th-2026)
  by TechieAndroid and contributors
  ([download](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Z8-pMx20xO8q3caiqy4NOrSNVT1veDSk/view); not included). **With the Korean
  patch** its own textures (logo, name plates, Hangul font and text) are never replaced. Phones without BC7 support
  get the textures decoded (Size: Half by default there). See [docs/texture_pack.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/texture_pack.md).
- **Multiplayer, no server.** Pause menu → **Multiplayer**: host a room in your town (public, or private with a room
  code and an optional password, 2–8 players), or find public rooms on your network and on the internet, or join by
  room code. Guests receive the host's town and **take the train from their own station** to visit; everyone sees
  everyone with their names, chat lines show over heads, and the outdoor items are shared: drop, pick up, place, dig,
  bury, plant, shake fruit down, chop trees, pull weeds. The host decides, can send players out (they can't come back
  in), and guests follow the host's clock. Over the internet it finds rooms through the BitTorrent DHT, learns its
  address with STUN and asks the router to open UDP port 47070 (UPnP); see
  [docs/multiplayer.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/multiplayer.md) for how and for the limits.
- On Linux, the Korean patch and texture packs can be picked with zenity or kdialog when one is installed.

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog).
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- Signed with the same key as before, so the APK installs over the previous version (saves and the Korean patch are
  kept).

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- **Multiplayer**: save your town once before hosting; the guest needs a saved town of its own (with another name).

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.0-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.0-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.0-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.0-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- Menus (Linux, Korean and original disc, with scripted keys, mouse clicks and touches): the pause page, every settings
  tab, key rebinding, installing the Korean patch from the menu (progress, Restart now), tabs and buttons by touch and a
  page scrolled by dragging.
- HD textures: the v25 zip read in place (18,858 textures indexed in Korean mode, 203 Localisation ones left out); the
  same scripted opening with and without it on the Korean disc: the Korean logo, name entry and dialogue are the
  patch's, the rest is HD.
- Multiplayer, two copies of the game with two saved towns: the guest joins, receives the town (467 KB), talks to the
  station master, saves its town to slot A and rides the train to the host's town ("동물마을에 어서 오세요!"); both
  see each other with their names; an item placed on either side appears on the other. The room protocol is unit
  tested with 15% of all packets lost, and the internet path (DHT announce, lookup, join by code) against a fake DHT
  node. It was not tried between two real networks.
- The decomp changes are inside `TARGET_PC` only; the matching build gives the same hashes.

## Known limitations

- Multiplayer shares the host's town only; villagers move on each machine by themselves; furniture moved inside houses
  is not shared; custom-design clothes show as the plain shirt to others.
- The SD card, GBA link and Card e-Reader are treated as "no device".
- Not yet tested much on real Windows or Android devices.

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
